text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API queue depth spike detected in us-west-2. enqueued=12.2k, p95=8.1s, p99=31.8s. auto-escalating to #incidents :rotating_light:

evon-oncall: taking it. grabbing current topo and recent deploys.

sre-lee: seeing steady enqueue from multiple tenants, provisioner failing to create new GPU nodes — create errors look like quota + timeout.

kube-provisioner-bot: create_node error: "googleapi: Error 403: Quota exceeded for 'NVIDIA_TESLA' in region us-west-2, quotaExceeded". attempt=6 backoff=10s

ops-rita: confirmed cloud quota error. Requesting quota increases won't be immediate. need short-term mitigation.

evon-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) throttle a few heavy tenants via rate-limits 2) failover low-priority requests to CPU-backed fallback model 3) open manual capacity from dedicated pool if possible. Assigning tasks.

support-jamie: starting customer triage. Pulling list of top 20 tenants by qps last 30m. Will flag any paying customers impacted.

sre-lee: can we enable adaptive-fallback routing? route requests for model:large -> model-medium for best-effort tenants. That should reduce GPU memory per request.

ops-rita: enabling model variant fallback now (canary 10% -> 50%) and raising per-tenant throttles for non-SLAs.

support-jamie: initial customer impact: 3 enterprise tenants showing errors/timeouts, ~12 smaller customers seeing elevated latencies. Support wave started.

evon-oncall: running quick script to drop enqueued requests older than 30s for best-effort queue (safe-drop).

sre-lee: note: safe-drop will drop some client requests. prefer throttles first. Proceed with care.

ops-rita: quick commands:
```
# reduce weight for best-effort routing
redwoodctl routing set-weight best-effort 0.4
# enable fallback to cpu model for non-sla
redwoodctl models set-fallback model:large->model:cpu-low
```

ops-rita: executed. provisioner still stuck creating GPU nodes due to quota. Manual pool expand not possible until quota cleared.

evon-oncall: opened cloud support ticket 123456789 to request emergency GPU quota uplift. ETA unknown.

pm-alyssa: we should prepare a status update for customers. support-jamie, can you draft? say: investigating, mitigation active, partial degraded performance for non-SLA traffic.

support-jamie: drafting status page now. will ping legal if enterprise contracts impacted.

sre-lee: early metrics after config changes: enqueued dropping to 6.5k, p95 4.2s, p99 18.6s. Improvement but still above SLO.

evon-oncall: handing off to night oncall @sre-lee in 30m. leave runbook notes: quota error, cloud ticket 123456789, fallback enabled, safe-drop script run twice.

ops-rita: added temporary tenant throttles list: tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c. will rollback once pool healthy.

support-jamie: customer comms sent to flagged enterprises. internal slack thread for exec update created.

sre-lee: next steps: monitor for 1h, if enqueue rebounds contact cloud support for escalation; prepare postmortem once incident stabilized.

evon-oncall: marking incident as "mitigated - active monitoring". paging stopped. handoff to nightshift in 30m. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT: status changed to "mitigated" by evon-oncall at 1780003045.

pm-alyssa: schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow AM. include provisioning fallback automation and quota playbook.

sre-lee: logging all commands and snapshots to the incident incident-runbook for postmortem.

support-jamie: last update: enqueued 3.1k, p95 2.3s, p99 7.9s. customers still seeing intermittent errors, but major degradation avoided.

evon-oncall: last checks OK. handing over. good job everyone.
